role: The base entity: position/motion/bounding-box state, moveEntity's collision sweep, the base tick (fire, water, lava, portal), NBT round-trip, riding, dimension travel, and the watched flags.
scope_reason: Every entity's state and movement flow through these fields and moveEntity; the tape digests gate them.
notes: Entity.java is the base of everything with an id; the record cites the shared core in entity.c and the living-side ports in living.c. The move gate is test_move.c against the oracle's Move.java probe (out/java/moves). Player-specific and item-specific halves of the base tick live in survival.c and item_entity.c and are indexed under those files. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): updateRidden runs (living.c:2739, update_ridden set in serverreplay.c) and the network fields are client plumbing; record is wrong on riding. Formerly listed as missing: setPositionAndRotation2 (the teleport-ack reposition with the stuck-box lift) has no counterpart; the portal transfer repositions directly. The network tracking fields (serverPosX/Y/Z), the render culling fields and EnumEntitySize.multiplyBy32AndRound: never reached server-side.

members.name: travelToDimension
members.note: non-players: sr_living_portal_travel (livings) and sr_ie_portal_travel (items, orbs, arrows, throwables), into the Nether, the overworld and the End (endportal-ents-s1): removeEntity undone, transferEntityToWorld through sr_travel_place with the destination entered, the old instance appended to the destination's list, its NBT copy behind it, both updateEntityTicks reset; the old one's update runs on dead in the new world. A mob in the End's exit portal (1 to 1) is not modelled. The player's is sr_transfer_player The source world is the Entity.dimension field, not the world the entity stands in: a summoned mob's field is 0 anywhere, so in the End's exit portal it goes to the End's entrance platform and the overworld's updateEntityTick is the one reset (end-exit-mob-s1). A traveller arriving where the player is pushes the player's own motion (portal-foreign-s1). The true End exit of a mob whose field is 1 (to the overworld spawn) is not modelled: its old instance's update goes on at eight times its position in the overworld, whose block reads load chunks.; the old instance spawned in the destination is tracked there at the chunk it stands in (combat_track_travelled, pfc-portalpig-s3); the old instance joins the destination chunk's list; when the rest of its update moves it off that chunk or section, the source world's chunk check retargets or clears its membership and it stays there as a ghost until the chunk unloads (serverreplay.c sr_living_portal_travel, sr_living_post_update; pfc-portalghost-s3); a falling block's End portal trip (serverreplay.c sr_fh_portal_travel, pfc-fallportal-f365); every item-pool entity knows the world whose lists hold it, a skeleton's arrow included (ie_added_to_world, pfc-arrowportal-s18)
